mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.45 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflation expectations, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1450.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 signals weakening real economic activity and declining corporate earnings momentum, which reduces equity risk premiums and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO falls below 102.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential investment (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand and inflationary pressure, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 3.1% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflation that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.1% and FEDFUNDS is stable or rising, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market that is both expanding and tightening, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.0, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a weakening economy with deteriorating corporate earnings, which triggers a flight to safety and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0 and UNRATE rises, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
